questions.question: What was the California statewide rate for uncomplicated cesarean deliveries in 2024?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_medical_procedure_utilization_rates.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1')
row = df[(df['Year'] == 2024) & (df['County'] == 'STATEWIDE') & (df['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated Cesarean Delivery')]
result = float(row['Rate'].iloc[0])

questions.question: In 2020, did Sutter Davis Hospital report a higher rate for uncomplicated VBAC than for uncomplicated cesarean delivery?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ca_hcai_medical_procedure_utilization_rates.xlsx', sheet_name='Sheet1')
hosp = df[(df['Year'] == 2020) & (df['Hospital'] == 'Sutter Davis Hospital')]
vbac_rate = float(hosp[hosp['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated VBAC']['Rate'].iloc[0])
cesarean_rate = float(hosp[hosp['Procedure'] == 'Uncomplicated Cesarean Delivery']['Rate'].iloc[0])
result = 'yes' if vbac_rate > cesarean_rate else 'no'
